description: This file defines the ProductOptionEntity class, which extends ProductOption and implements Serializable. It includes private fields for order, code, and type, along with their respective getter and setter methods. The class appears to be part of the product attribute management in the catalog module of the web application.

classes.name: ProductOptionEntity
classes.description: A serializable entity class representing product options with additional attributes order, code, and type, extending the base ProductOption class.
